## Circuit descriptions (smallest instance m=4, k=2 so the diagrams stay readable; qubit 0 on top)
Legend: `@` control on 1, `o` control on 0, `Ry` rotation target, `+` CNOT target, `Z` member of a multi-controlled Z, `X` bit flip.

**Dicke state |D_2^4> from |0000> (explicit-amplitude tree of multiplexed RY; DEVIATION: not the Baertschi-Eidenbenz O(kL) circuit):**
```
q0: -------------------Ry-Ry-Ry
q1: ----------Ry-Ry-Ry-@--o--o-
q2: ----Ry-Ry-o--@--o--o--@--o-
q3: -Ry-o--@--o--o--@--o--o--@-
```
**Phase oracle marking x = 0011 (X on the zero bits, MCZ on all qubits, X again):**
```
q0: -------Z-------
q1: -------Z-------
q2: -X-----Z--X----
q3: ----X--Z-----X-
```
**Reflection I - 2|D><D| = Tree^dagger . X^n . MCZ . X^n . Tree (first 30 ops shown):**
```
q0: -Ry-Ry-Ry-------------------X-----------Z--X-----------------------------Ry-Ry-Ry
q1: -o--o--@--Ry-Ry-Ry-------------X--------Z-----X-----------------Ry-Ry-Ry-@--o--o-
q2: -o--@--o--o--@--o--Ry-Ry----------X-----Z--------X--------Ry-Ry-o--@--o--o--@--o-
q3: -@--o--o--@--o--o--@--o--Ry----------X--Z-----------X--Ry-o--@--o--o--@--o--o--@-
```
A full Grover circuit is: Tree (prepare |D>), then r x [phase oracle, reflection], then measurement of all m qubits.
